RF01.name: Direct imperative
RF01.instruction: Begin with one direct action verb appropriate to the assigned output type.

RF02.name: How-question
RF02.instruction: Begin with How and ask one complete question.

RF03.name: What-question
RF03.instruction: Begin with What and ask one complete question.

RF04.name: Which-question
RF04.instruction: Begin with Which and ask one complete question.

RF05.name: Why-question
RF05.instruction: Begin with Why and ask one diagnostic or explanatory question.

RF06.name: Modal question
RF06.instruction: Begin with Can you, Could you, Would you, or Will you and ask one question.

RF07.name: First-person request
RF07.instruction: Begin with I need, I want, or I would like, followed by one clear request.

RF08.name: Help-me request
RF08.instruction: Begin with Help me and use one clear request verb.

RF09.name: Contextual request
RF09.instruction: Begin with a short In, Under, Within, For, or Given context clause, then state one clear request.

RF10.name: Comparison request
RF10.instruction: Begin with Compare or Contrast and request one chemically coherent comparison.

RF11.name: Selection request
RF11.instruction: Begin with Select, Choose, Recommend, or Which and request one defensible choice.

RF12.name: Diagnosis request
RF12.instruction: Begin with Diagnose, Troubleshoot, Why, or What is causing and request one diagnosis.
